# Vendored dependency

Project: hugo-paper by nanxiaobei
Source: https://github.com/nanxiaobei/hugo-paper
Revision: b32d526a3e7764cc6dbb3ce3cad86748adf40c2c (2023-06-07)
License: MIT; the original LICENSE and asset notices are retained.

This is an unmodified export of the runtime directories: assets, layouts, static,
i18n, and theme.toml. Site-specific changes stay in blog/layouts and blog/assets.
No Git metadata, example site, development dependencies, or network bootstrap is
required for a site build. blog/theme-version.txt records the selected revision.
